patient_synopsis.authored_text: Mary Louis (1972-03-18) is a 54-year-old woman with nonischemic DCM/HFrEF diagnosed in 04/2026, LVEF 35% on June MRI, functional MR/TR, suspected familial cardiomyopathy, AUD, HTN, and HLD. [[patient_source|8e59cfd7-2253-4bbd-b6c8-29e6ec8f396b|71cc8da7-244e-4009-9194-d393ddce9748]] Following April admission with decompensated HF and low-output physiology, she remained NYHA II–III with mild congestion on June 23, 2026; BP was 128/78 and HR 58. [[patient_source|0a3e17ee-afd1-49f2-9b21-e20cc1615620|6d544dcb-33df-4120-abda-4554b6058ea7]] [[patient_source|a3461709-e647-4eef-963a-e02fa1be1d3b|bb3940e4-4332-4be3-b368-f23931479e03]] She reported adherence to furosemide 40 mg daily, valsartan 40 mg daily, and spironolactone 25 mg daily; cardiology prescribed furosemide 40 mg twice daily for one week, then daily, with weight review at one week and chemistry at two weeks. [[patient_source|a3461709-e647-4eef-963a-e02fa1be1d3b|bb3940e4-4332-4be3-b368-f23931479e03]] Beta blockade remained deferred because of HR 58 and recent low output, while SGLT2 initiation and ARB uptitration/ARNI conversion awaited reassessment. [[patient_source|a3461709-e647-4eef-963a-e02fa1be1d3b|bb3940e4-4332-4be3-b368-f23931479e03]] Her son's LV non-compaction and maternal cardiac history supported suspected familial disease, although her MRI did not meet LV non-compaction criteria. [[patient_source|77740b8b-491c-4728-bd74-08ab43c1e856|c1921785-e541-4ffb-9fbd-27ab655c0d37]] [[patient_source|a3461709-e647-4eef-963a-e02fa1be1d3b|bb3940e4-4332-4be3-b368-f23931479e03]] Alcohol intake remained a concern with re-referral accepted after noncontact with the service, and recurrent ibuprofen use prompted renewed avoidance counseling; lipid-lowering treatment was unclear because the June note described HLD as treated but listed no lipid-lowering drug. [[patient_source|a3461709-e647-4eef-963a-e02fa1be1d3b|bb3940e4-4332-4be3-b368-f23931479e03]] Outstanding items are current volume status and diuretic dose, weight/chemistry results and GDMT reassessment, July genetics attendance/results, alcohol-service engagement and current intake, NSAID exposure, lipid-treatment reconciliation, and repeat echo to reassess ventricular/valve function and the conditional ICD plan if LVEF remained ≤35% after at least three months of optimized therapy. [[patient_source|a3461709-e647-4eef-963a-e02fa1be1d3b|bb3940e4-4332-4be3-b368-f23931479e03]]

Discharge Summary — New Non-Ischaemic Cardiomyopathy with Acute Decompensated Heart Failure
ALLERGIES: none known.
ADMISSION 04/06/2026. DISCHARGE 04/13/2026. Length of stay 8 days.
